title: Oakville man killed wife before being shot by police
article: An Oakville man stabbed his wife to death before he was fatally shot by police in January, Halton Regional Police have concluded.
Katherine Newman, 43, was found dead in her Oakville home just before noon on Jan. 12. An autopsy showed she had been stabbed multiple times.
Her husband, Kyle Newman, was shot dead that same day by police in the parking lot of the Halton Regional Police Station located at 95 Oak Walk Dr. in Oakville.
The SIU concluded officers were justified in shooting Newman, and evidence determined he was responsible for the murder of his wife.
